title: InterConRank: Joint Node Centrality in Interconnected Heterogeneous Networks
abstract: arXiv:2611.34763v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Two nodes with identical connections within their own layer can differ in importance if their neighbors in another layer occupy different positions in the network. We introduce InterConRank, a centrality algorithm that computes a separate node ranking for each layer of an interconnected network. Directed dependencies specify which layers supply scores to each receiving layer. InterConRank normalizes each type of link separately and updates all layers together, so a score can cross into a layer in one iteration and propagate along its internal links in the next. We prove convergence of this joint update and evaluate the resulting rankings on four scholarly networks. On all four networks, InterConRank gives the highest rank correlations with both h-index and total citations for nodes in the collaboration layer.

translated_title: InterConRank：互联异构网络中的联合节点中心性
translated_abstract: 即使两个节点在其所在层内部具有完全相同的连接，如果它们在另一层中的邻居占据网络中不同的位置，它们的重要性也可能不同。我们提出了 InterConRank，一种为互联网络的每一层分别计算节点排名的中心性算法。有向依赖关系指定了哪些层为每个接收层提供分数。InterConRank 对每种类型的链接分别进行归一化，并同时更新所有层，因此一个分数可以在一次迭代中跨层传入某一层，并在下一次迭代中沿该层内部的链接进行传播。我们证明了这种联合更新的收敛性，并在四个学术网络上评估了所得的排名。在全部四个网络上，对于协作层中的节点，InterConRank 与 h 指数和总引用次数都给出了最高的排名相关性。
tldr: 提出了 InterConRank 算法，通过有向跨层依赖与联合迭代更新为互联异构网络的每一层计算节点中心性排名，并在四个学术网络上的协作层中取得了与 h 指数和总引用次数最高的排名相关性。
en_tdlr: Proposes InterConRank, a centrality algorithm that jointly updates node rankings across interconnected heterogeneous network layers via directed dependencies, achieving the highest rank correlations with h-index and total citations on four scholarly networks.
